title: In a plan-mode review, allow slicer goals, slicer list, and go test without an approval prompt.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-215731-f05c, project ork, item S397:

In a plan-mode review, allow slicer goals, slicer list, and go test without an approval prompt.

Evidence: The brief says an approval ends the run, and Done when says slicer and test commands stay unverified, so this review traced the five tests and did not execute them.
